    draws on which the two populations disagree about PRESENCE (>=90 %): 0
    (a spread printed above without DISAGREE is a difference of DEGREE:
     POP-B reaches much further down the slack distribution, so a draw on
     which only the very worst cone carries the round trip shows a high
     POP-A fraction and a low POP-B one.  AX-3 is live in DEGREE even where
     it is not live in PRESENCE.)
